purpose: 오르벨 에어 퍼스트클래스: 독립 스위트, 완전히 펼친 침대, 전용 콘솔과 대형 화면이 보이는 2:5 세로 배경
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: finished background for a FIRST CLASS airline-suite relaxation scene, one very tall 2:5 portrait photograph. Create an entirely NEW composition.

Primary subject: an unequivocal ultra-premium FIRST CLASS PRIVATE ENCLOSED SUITE inside a commercial long-haul airliner. It should read as a private flying bedroom at first glance. Make the SPACIOUS SUITE and its FULL-LENGTH BED the subject. The aircraft windows are relatively small secondary details, NOT a window close-up.

Camera: immersive first-person view from reclining at the head of my wide fully flat bed, looking toward the far end of MY OWN PRIVATE SUITE. No body parts. A natural moderately wide rectilinear lens includes both sides of this private space without distortion. In the foreground, a generous full-width flat mattress with crisp white cotton linen, a lofty white duvet gently turned down and one tailored deep-navy blanket stripe, extending a believable full adult bed length toward a broad padded cream ottoman at the far end. There is obviously ample legroom and private floor space.

Architecture and unmistakable FIRST CLASS cues:
- Tall sculpted warm-ivory privacy walls enclosing this single suite, up to near ceiling height.
- A proper tall sliding suite door on the far RIGHT, slightly open just enough to reveal a tiny quiet glimpse of the aircraft aisle, no other passenger seats.
- A very large clean dark switched-off entertainment screen mounted on the FAR END wall above the ottoman, large and comfortably far away. Screen contains no content or text.
- A broad continuous dark walnut and champagne-metal SIDE CONSOLE running along the RIGHT beside the bed, with a soft cream leather armrest, a modest warm reading lamp and neatly integrated unmarked controls.
- Along the LEFT curved aircraft sidewall, THREE small realistic oval aircraft windows spaced naturally, with dark-blue twilight and soft clouds outside. Windows occupy a minor part of the picture and recede in perspective.
- Elegant aircraft ceiling panels and soft recessed champagne lighting; refined pale leather, matte warm-ivory cabinetry, tactile navy textiles. All believable as a real state-of-the-art commercial FIRST CLASS enclosed suite.

Mood: serene and intimate, warm cream and soft honey light, calm navy accents, quiet premium hospitality. Not flashy or gilded. The fictional airline is ORVEL AIR, context only; NO name, lettering, logos, monograms or signage anywhere. Do not print the brand.

Critical composition: BED AND ENCLOSED SUITE ARCHITECTURE DOMINATE THE CENTRAL IMAGE. Show the entire length of the bed and far suite wall. Do not crop to the sidewall/window or to a seatback. The top of the frame includes the cozy ceiling, bottom is softly textured white duvet, main recognizable suite around central 25-70% of height. One full-bleed very tall 2:5 portrait, ideally 1024x2560, sharp premium realistic interior photography with natural materials, gentle exposure and no CGI styling. Layout must remain identifiable at narrow card size.

Absolutely avoid: economy seating, business-class pod, upright seatbacks, rows of seats, small seat pitch, seat-back trays, seat pockets, close-up giant window, hotel bedroom architecture, private-jet lounge, dining table, food, wine, flowers, clutter, people, hands, feet, text, letters, numbers, watermarks, borders, UI, collage, any visible screen content. Deliver ONE finished first-class suite photographic background.
